summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Dr. Haojun Wang as joint company secretary, effective June 10, 2026, alongside existing secretary Mr. Ng. The filing also discloses a waiver from strict compliance with Hong Kong Listing Rules 3.28 and 8.17 regarding Dr. Wang's qualifications. This is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation event. No terms, premium, or deal mechanics are involved. As a foreign private issuer's non-material administrative filing, it does not constitute an activist, M&A, or restructuring event; risk-arb is not applicable.
